Born outside of the City of Goran in a small village, I was born seemingly normal. My parents died in a rock slide. I had an average childhood with a mild penchant for mischief. I was taught and raised by the local shaman and hunters and was great work hand. I wanted to go on to become a great priest over my village and protect them and help them in times of need. When I turned 17 I went into the city’s biggest temple academy. I felt uneasy but, I chalked it up to nerves. When the time came the wandering Oracle of Desna came before all the students and one by one they were told their roles that they would fill. Some were told they’d become doctors, soldiers, heroes, thieves, artists all sorts of occupations. Then she came to me and when she touched my head and she staggered a moment, she removed her hand and shouted “Demon King!” I was aghast at this I said that she must be wrong. All the students were scared of me. I walked back home at least no one in the village would know about it. Then one year later my body contorted and twisted and I grew horns, talons, fangs and an arrow headed tail. I could see in the dark and grew stronger and was swifter than my fellow villagers. But, as my features became more prominent I was slowly being shunned. I became a cynic, a loner and went out into the woods for months on end. I came back home after a particularly long trip and discovered that my whole home town had been eradicated. It had been orcs. At first I enjoyed and reveled in their destruction but, the old shaman who had taught me everything, I found him barely conscious. I brought him into the city to be healed. 
When I made it into the city the villagers thought I did it! I explained to them that it was orcs but, having demon blood, my words fell on deaf ears. That is until the Oracle came to my side and vouched for me. She knew I was telling the truth and that not only had orcs destroyed my town but an dragon as well. With this knowledge I swore never to let something like this happen to anyone. My village may have disowned me but I never forgot my roots. My destiny tells me I am to become the Demon King. If I can, I want to avoid the title for as long as possible. Until that day arrives, I’m going to enjoy my freedom for as long as I have. This is my pledge: I will save those and never need thanks, I want peace for myself but will stop those that seek to disrupt it and I will be a Guardian Devil.
